key_difference: (D) re-decodes %80–%FF as UTF-8 inside decode() using a new traits struct, where (B) relies on valid UTF-8 already being folded to UTF-16 and rejects every remaining byte >= 0x80; (D) also never rejects literal (unencoded) backslashes on Windows, which (B) catches with an up-front precheck because QUrl stores them in decoded form.
